messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: error-rate > 5% on inference-api-prod (p95 latency OK). Alert rule: infra/llm/error-rate-high. Triggered 1752403120
ana (oncall): grabbing it. paging eng-sre and eng-runtime.
mike: on it — pulling recent traces. did this start after the 03:00 deploy?
ana (oncall): deploys in last 6hrs: none on inference-api-prod, small bump on autoscaler.
kevin: can you paste the alert graph?
ana (oncall): https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abc123/error-rate?orgId=1 (clip) — error spikes on 2025-10-04T15:05Z, sustained ~7m
sara: initial customer reports are 2 accounts complaining about truncated responses. maybe upstream timeouts.
jess (se): seeing 504s from model pool A in eu-west-1, logs show KV cache misses increased. copying log snippet:
```
2025-10-04T15:05:23Z inference-api-prod request_id=... pool=A status=504 backend_error="context deadline exceeded" kv_cache_hit=false
2025-10-04T15:06:01Z inference-api-prod request_id=... pool=A status=200 kv_cache_hit=false
```
kevin: hmm KV cache warming issue after a redis failover? checking redis metrics.
mike: redis replica resync around 15:03Z, high latency there. that aligns.
ana (oncall): customer impact: degraded quality for some long-context requests, 2 support tickets. will mark SEV3 for visibility.
ana (oncall): temporary mitigation: routing new traffic away from pool A -> pool B, enabling fallback-model-lightweight for requests hitting >2s backend latency. can someone flip routing?
jess (se): I can change the routing policy, will do canary to 10% first.
kevin: also recommend muting infra/llm/error-rate for 30m while we stabilize, and create a follow-up to tune alert thresholds to avoid noise.
mike: +1 mute while we act. creating incident channel #incident-1752403120 for runbook notes.
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1752403120 by ana (oncall)
ana (oncall): handoff: I'm staying on for the next 25m. @kevin you'll take postmortem + dashboards?
kevin: taking postmortem and dashboards. will own follow-ups.
sara: router change pushed to 10% canary at 15:12Z — observing.
jess (se): canary looks good, no spike in 504s on pool B. increasing to 50%.
mike: redis resync finished 15:20Z, replica lag cleared. KV cache hit ratio back to baseline 15:24Z.
nana (oncall): increasing traffic routing back to 100% at 15:26Z. monitoring.
nana (oncall): marking alert resolved in the alerting system at 15:28Z — reason: transient infra failover; mitigation: routing fallback + redis recovery.
kevin: action items for follow-up: 1) alert tuning: change infra/llm/error-rate to require sustained >5% for 5m (currently 1m), add suppress-on-degraded-backend tag; 2) dashboard: build incident-retro dashboard that surfaces golden signals per pool, KV cache hit %, redis replica lag, and drilldown links to traces and support tickets; 3) runbook snippet for redis failover detection and automated routing fallback.
nana (oncall): please add owners and due dates.
kevin: creating dashboard skeleton now — will add panels:
- Golden signals row: p99 latency, p95 latency, error rate (per-pool)
- Pool health: pool capacity utilization, active requests per GPU, KV cache hit %
- Redis cluster: replica lag, inflight replication ops, SWAP/memory usage
- Drilldowns: link panels to trace filter with `request_id` and to the support ticket search (support://search?q=incident-1752403120)
kevin: panel queries (rough) for KV cache hit %:
```
avg by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m]) / (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[1m]))) * 100
```
kevin: and for per-pool error rate:
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-api\",status=~\"5..\",pool!=\"\"}[1m])) by (pool)
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-api\",pool!=\"\"}[1m])) by (pool)) * 100
```
sara: add annotation when we muted alert and when we changed routing — helps retros.
kevin: good call — adding annotations: mute at 15:14Z, routing canary 15:12Z, full reroute 15:26Z, resolved 15:28Z.
mike: recommend also adding a percentile heatmap of request durations to spot tail behavior.
jess (se): I'll file the runbook PR for automated fallback: proposed logic: if redis replica lag > 30s OR kv_cache_hit% < 70% for 2m then switch pool priority and post incident-bot note.
kevin: assigning dashboard work to me, due 2025-10-08. runbook PR assigned to jess, due 2025-10-06. alert tuning assigned to ana to shepherd with monitoring team, due 2025-10-05.
nana (oncall): adding note to the incident channel about customer impact and support tickets.
incident-bot: Reminder: Add postmortem template at /incidents/1752403120/postmortem.md
kevin: once dashboard is in, will link it from postmortem and tag owners. planning to include small how-to for drilldowns in the retro.
sara: +1, also recommend we create a dashboard variant scoped to dedicated customers for next retro.
nana (oncall): thanks team — I'm unpaging but will stay reachable. good job on rapid mitigation. :thumbsup:
kevin: will follow up with the dashboard PR and postmortem draft tomorrow.
jess (se): will open the runbook PR in ~30m.
mike: closing the incident channel logs into the incident tracker.
nana (oncall): closing pager.
incident-bot: Incident 1752403120 status: resolved.
